crossRefs.note: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, So that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.
He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.
“Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.
Come, see Yahweh’s works, what desolations he has made in the earth.
All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.
For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Yahweh, have done it.
Yahweh’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.
then I saw all the work of God, that man can’t find out the work that is done under the sun, because however much a man…
The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh…
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…

translations.web: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.
translations.bsb: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.
translations.kjv: He sealeth up the hand of every man; that all men may know his work.
translations.asv: He sealeth up the hand of every man, That all men whom he hath made may know it.
